model_condition: Saved common mask, MC median, sigma and HL factors fixed; current decode reclassified. Not a full refit of the current MC residual population.
formula: z=((LG-pedLG)-(HG-pedHG)/A+B/A-mc_median)/noise_sigma_LG_ADC; low iff z<-5; event iff >=3 distinct physical cells
hit_selection: HitTag=1; 800<=HG_raw<2200; saved common=1 (connected good channels); physical CellID present in current Calib_Hit

content_change_evidence.method: Same saved event IDs, old tail event energy/good_hits compared with current calibration using saved physical good mask. Raw ADC checked against saved tail_hits.
